agentGuidance.purpose: Jev "System One" connector backed by OpenAI: fast structured choice/score/noul answers over an arbitrary JSON state, plus model discovery, through a sealed per-machine OpenAI API key.
agentGuidance.when: The task needs a fast classification, ranking, or yes/no judgement over some state (page content, a document, a list of options) rather than free-form generation, or needs to know which Jev models are available.
agentGuidance.recipe: Call jev.status first. If state is 'not-connected' or 'invalid-key', call jev.connect to show the sign-in card and stop until the user connects. Once connected, call jev.ask with { model?, state, questions } (see criteria for 'choice' | 'score' | 'noul' question kinds) or jev.models.list to see available models.
agentGuidance.boundaries: The API key never appears in any capability output or log. jev.ask forwards 'state'/'questions' verbatim to OpenAI - do not put secrets there. Answers are validated (choice in options, probabilities sum to ~1) before returning; invalid responses error, never get silently repaired.

contracts.docs: JevClient v1.0.0: status() reports connection state without ever returning the key; ask(request, options) calls OpenAI POST /v1/chat/completions with Structured Outputs, validates every choice/score/noul answer, retries 429/503/529 up to twice with backoff, and throws typed JevClientError (JEV_NOT_CONNECTED | JEV_INVALID_KEY | JEV_RATE_LIMITED | JEV_UNAVAILABLE | JEV_BAD_REQUEST | JEV_INVALID_RESPONSE | JEV_ABORTED); listModels() calls OpenAI GET /v1/models. Bound at Symbol.for('@marshal/jev:client'). Raw API keys are never returned to callers.

defaultModel.description: OpenAI model used when a request omits 'model' or names a legacy 'jev-*' model. Defaults to 'gpt-5-mini'.

apiBaseUrl.description: Overrides the OpenAI API base URL (default https://api.openai.com). Testing/proxy escape hatch only.

stateDir.description: Sealed-credential-state persistence root. A filesystem location, never a value - defaults to .marshal-state/jev-openai when absent.

reasoningEffort.description: Optional reasoning_effort sent to OpenAI reasoning models. Defaults to 'minimal' for gpt-5 / gpt-5-mini / gpt-5-nano, otherwise unset.
